status.description: done: the acceptance criteria are met. failed: you tried and could not. blocked: you cannot proceed without a decision or access only your hirer can give.

summary.description: One or two sentences. This is the first thing your hirer reads.

details.description: What your hirer needs beyond the summary: decisions you made and why, test results, caveats.

open_questions.description: Questions only your hirer can answer. Empty if there are none.
